title: Bokurano
content:
I've always thought of My Hero Academia OSTs as one of its strongest points, even on its lowest, it has been the climax of my enjoyment of this series, and even then, I have to say that Bokurano is one of its best entries and it's saying a lot. There is nothing you can hate about a catchy and upbeat song that perfectly captures the spirit of the show. It's one of those melodies that gets you signing along, even when you don't understand any word of it, humming along is more than satisfying.

The visuals, although simple, they speak volumes. Yes, it's just a character on a white background, but when the song and lyrics drive the pace, the visual is nothing but a compliment for it. It doesn't distract away from the vibes that the song is trying to capture.
